Dani & Lenny, Quat Quatta Ripponlea Victoria 


'I wanted a dress that was modern, timeless, and chic! It was a strapless A-line dress with a sculptured back feature, in a structured plain fabric as I felt the silhouette and details on the gown did all the talking.'


'I walked down the aisle to “Sleeping At Last” by Turning Page. The ceremony was actually pretty nerve-racking, but also really special. We were married at St. Brendan’s Church in Flemington and our priest got the crowd involved which was also a highlight and a few laughs!'


'Flowers played such a big part in our day – they really set the scene and added instant beauty! We went with classic white reflexed roses for the bouquets by Basia Pulchaski '


'Relaxing with the girls and my parents before the big day, and then having a relaxed afternoon with Lenny & our wedding party with cocktails and delicious food at the Ripponlea Food & Wine Bar before the big party started were some of my favourite moments of the day!'
